text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the efforts (and pocket money) of Director Akikawa, a Pro Shop has opened up within the school store! It boasts a wide variety of useful training items.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What's more, these items can be obtained by exchanging Pro Shop coins rather than spending regular money.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hear that coins are awarded based on race results. So let's earn as many as possible and put them to good use!
